fieldValues.title: Evidence-backed writing
fieldValues.purpose: Help one writer build a carefully structured text, in their own words, where every claim is valid and can stand up to critical argument. Agents respond to the writing; they never write it. The first case is the owner writing pieces for muDemocracy against the muSrs research base of problems and claims.
fieldValues.in_scope: The writer drafts; agents respond by linking the text to claims, problems and quotes in muSrs. Red-team agents challenge claims; blue-team agents find evidence that backs them. Checking each claim against the evidence base. Keeping abandoned framings as attempts to review later. Starting from a blank page, from a news article being answered, or from a recorded conversation's transcript.
fieldValues.out_of_scope: Agents drafting or rewriting the writer's text. Several authors on one text (a later generalisation). Academic citation formats. Publishing and distribution. Saving work outside the editor and reintegrating it, as a technical concern (it also belongs to a separate, technical domain).
